verdict.rationale: Langfuse documents a dedicated "Code Evaluators" feature for deterministic checks. It also supports fully custom evaluation workflows via its API/SDKs, including Scores via API/SDK, SDK-driven experiments with `run_experiment`, and numeric, categorical, or boolean score types. A community user also describes building an external evaluation pipeline that feeds scores back into Langfuse. Missing for 10: detailed docs on how code evaluators are authored and run (language, managed vs. client-side, metric aggregation), and independent hands-on corroboration of writing custom scorers.
